_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Imreoir Snake ar ghréasán {width}×{height}.
Tá tú i gceannas ar an nathair {player_id}. Gluaiseachtaí bailí: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (nó w/s/a/d).
Cuspóir: maireachtáil don tréimhse is faide nó bualadh don scór is airde (teorainn {max_turns} uathroisc).

game_action.invalid_death: Fuair Snake {player_id} bás mar gheall ar ghluaiseacht neamhbhailí.

outcome.survived_win: D'éirigh leis an imreoir {player_id} maireachtáil; fuair na daoine eile bás.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Fuair na nathair go léir bás ag an am céanna.
outcome.outlived: D'éirigh le himreoir maireachtáil don tréimhse is faide.
outcome.turn_limit: Tá an teorainn tiontaithe bainte amach - is é an scór is fearr a bhuaigh na comhréiteach.
